summary.text: Kirk White is a Democratic member of the Vermont House of Representatives for the Windsor-Addison District who lives in Bethel and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as an acupuncturist, an author and a lecturer.

paragraphs.text: Kirk White was born in Randolph, Vermont, and earned a B.A. in psychology and religion from the University of Vermont in 1984 and an M.A. in counseling from Johnson State College in 1996.
White founded the Bethel Revitalization Initiative and co-founded Bethel University.
White has been assigned to the Commerce and Economic Development Committee since the 2021-2022 session.
